05-28.title: Forbes replaces Ward as prime minister
05-28.text: George Forbes took over as United Party prime minister from the ailing Sir Joseph Ward as the Depression deepened.

05-28.title: Anti-apartheid protest in Christchurch
05-28.text: A protest against sporting contact with South Africa was held in Cathedral Square, part of a movement that peaked during the 1981 Springbok tour.

05-28.title: Green Party founded
05-28.text: The Green Party of Aotearoa New Zealand was founded at a conference in late May 1990, growing out of the Values Party and environmental groups.
